_comment: PROVENANCE: documented-shape SAMPLES, not a live capture. Assembled by hand on 2026-09-15 and
corrected on 2026-09-15 against the Helius reference for getTokenAccountsByOwnerV2
(helius.dev/docs/api-reference/rpc/http/gettokenaccountsbyownerv2).
FROM THAT REFERENCE: the request takes [owner, { programId }, { encoding, limit (1..10000),
paginationKey?, changedSinceSlot?, withContext?, commitment? }]; the response WITHOUT withContext
puts the ARRAY of token accounts at result.value with the cursor beside it at result.paginationKey,
and WITH withContext: true puts result.context = { slot, apiVersion } and moves both into
result.value = { accounts, paginationKey }; end of pagination is only indicated when no token
accounts are returned. Each account carries pubkey, account.lamports, account.owner (the token
program) and account.data.parsed.info with .mint and .tokenAmount { amount (raw string), decimals,
uiAmount }. Those two envelopes are built by test/helpers/heliusFixture.js around the samples below,
so both variants are exercised rather than assumed.
getAccountInfo answers { context, value } and, with encoding: 'jsonParsed', a Token-2022 mint
carries its extensions as info.extensions[] entries of { extension, state } - the two the check
reads are named metadataPointer and tokenGroupMember. THIS HALF IS STILL DOCUMENTATION-DERIVED and
has not been confirmed against a live mainnet mint.
getMultipleAccounts (same reference site, rpc/http/getmultipleaccounts) takes [[...pubkeys],
{ encoding }] and answers result.value: an array in the SAME ORDER as the request, null for a
pubkey the RPC does not know, and each other element the same per-account shape getAccountInfo
returns for one account - so the mintAccount sample below serves both call shapes unchanged.
The three values the check compares against (the Genesis Token's mint authority and the collection
address its metadata pointer and token group both name) come from the Solana Mobile documentation
for engaging Seeker users, not from this fixture's own sample data.
Placeholders (OWNER_WALLET, TOKEN_ACCOUNT, TOKEN_MINT, TOKEN_AMOUNT, MINT_AUTHORITY,
METADATA_ADDRESS, GROUP_ADDRESS) are resolved by test/helpers/heliusFixture.js.
Fields no production code reads (lamports, space, rentEpoch, the tokenMetadata extension, ...)
are kept only so the fixture looks like what the RPC actually returns.
